result.result: The new ECMWF IFS run (24 Jan 00z) shows heavy weather continuing well beyond the period the office previously warned about (23–26 Jan). The first stretch (24 Jan 1200–26 Jan 0100, Beaufort 7, 6.2 m seas) overlaps the earlier warning. What is new are additional stretches from 27 Jan to 29 Jan: a severe spell on 27–28 Jan (Beaufort 9, 5.5 m seas, head seas), then further Beaufort 7 spells on 28–29 Jan with seas up to 4.2 m, all on the bow or head. The Master already has the weather routing service's advice and his own judgement; the office supports whatever he decides. Please advise if the ETA changes. Stay safe, ship and crew.
